# Unitree G1 assets

Official Unitree G1 23-DOF model, `g1_23dof_mode_10.urdf`, from
[unitreerobotics/unitree_ros](https://github.com/unitreerobotics/unitree_ros/tree/725b59b6de39a26c425632120c89f23c49a36f1e/robots/g1_description).

- Revision: `725b59b6de39a26c425632120c89f23c49a36f1e`.
- License: BSD 3-Clause; the complete upstream text is in `LICENSE`.
- Copyright: 2016–2022 HangZhou YuShu TECHNOLOGY CO., LTD. (Unitree Robotics).
- Included: original URDF and only its 26 referenced STL meshes (about 23 MiB).
- `PROVENANCE.json` records upstream paths, immutable download URLs, file sizes,
  GitHub blob identifiers where available, and SHA-256 checksums.
- Upstream model files are preserved without modifications. Course adaptations
  belong outside this vendor directory.

This upstream description does not itself provide a ROS 2 Jazzy / Gazebo Harmonic
control stack. The lesson adds its own launch, controller, and observation setup.
The model and these teaching materials do not constitute a real-robot controller.
